body.name: legal Gaussian covariance-shift SCM class
body.construction: \(\mathcal M_{d,E,r}=\{\mu_{d,E,r}: B_{\mu}\text{ is acyclic};\ (H_e,\varepsilon_e,\eta_e)\text{ obey the centered Gaussian and independence conditions};\ \operatorname{Cov}(H_e)=\Omega_{H,\mu};\ \operatorname{Cov}(\eta_e)=\Omega_{\eta,\mu};\ \omega_{0,\mu}>0;\ \Omega_{\eta,\mu}\succ0;\ |T_{\mu}|=r;\ \lambda_{ej}=0\text{ off }T_{\mu};\ \lambda_{ej}\ge0\text{ on }T_{\mu};\ \forall j\in T_{\mu}\ \exists e\in\{1,\ldots,E\}:\lambda_{ej}>0\}\).
